name: HIGH-VIX band contrarian long — bb_z stretch reversion inside the fear window
rationale: Thesis: price stretched far below its band (bb_z lt z_floor, a z-score level gate) reverts hardest when it happens inside an elevated-but-not-broken-vol window. Use vix_level with the BETWEEN op to require VIX inside an armed band (above complacency, below a blow-up ceiling) — the regime where reversion is reliable rather than a regime-change crash. Exit when the z-stretch closes back above z_exit or risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (is the VIX band load-bearing?): the same bb_z-stretch long with NO VIX condition is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the band adds nothing and this is plain Bollinger reversion. Disconfirmer 2 (band-edge sensitivity): if the edge depends on a razor-thin band that the holdout cannot reproduce, it is over-fit. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must stay positive.
catalyst: price z-score stretched below band while VIX inside an armed band
